q: When heat is transferred from one object to another object, the total heat lost by one object is equal to the total _____ by the other object.
e: Heat is energy flowing because of a temperature difference. SI unit is the joule. When heat is transferred from one object to another object, the total heat lost by one object is equal to the total heat gained by the other object. Do not trade heat gained for work done or energy lost.

q: Since heat is a form of energy, the law of heat exchange is one particular statement of the law of _____ of energy.
e: Heat is energy flowing because of a temperature difference. SI unit is the joule. Since heat is a form of energy, the law of heat exchange is one particular statement of the law of conservation of energy. Do not trade conservation for transformation or dissipation.

q: A calorimeter is a device used to measure the _____ of a chemical reaction or physical change.
e: A calorimeter measures heat by the temperature change of a known mass of water. A calorimeter is a device used to measure the heat flow of a chemical reaction or physical change. Do not trade heat flow for temperature change or pressure change.

q: A calorimeter mainly consists of a metallic vessel made of copper or _____.
e: A calorimeter measures heat by the temperature change of a known mass of water. A calorimeter mainly consists of a metallic vessel made of copper or aluminium. Iron or lead is not this quantity.

q: The metallic vessel with a stirrer is kept in an insulating jacket to prevent heat lost to the _____.
e: Heat is energy flowing because of a temperature difference. SI unit is the joule. The metallic vessel with a stirrer is kept in an insulating jacket to prevent heat lost to the environment. Do not trade environment for surrounding water or thermometer.
